ideas.title: Show Only The Next Five Tasks
ideas.why: HouseSpouse's Home screen shows the next task plus a few coming up, five at most, with one-tap Done, Snooze, or Reschedule, so members feel ahead instead of buried.

ideas.title: Seasonal HVAC Tune-Up Reminders
ideas.why: ENERGY STAR advises a cooling check-up in spring and a heating check-up in fall, timed around the clock changes, and checking the air filter monthly (change at least every three months).
steps: Every month: check the air filter
Every 3 months at most: change the filter

ideas.title: Free Tier Plus Shareable Schedule
ideas.why: SeasonKeep offers one home free with no card, then a paid plan adding history, cost tracking, a shareable read-only schedule, and CSV export. A similar ladder could lower the barrier to a Home Record membership.
ideas.before: Paid membership is the only way in
ideas.after: Free starter schedule; paid adds history, sharing, export

ideas.title: Summary First, Details On Tap
ideas.why: NN/g's progressive disclosure guidance: show the most important options first and reveal specialized ones on request, which improves learnability, efficiency, and error rate.
ideas.before: Every brief shows full text at once
ideas.after: One-line summary per tile; tap to expand

ideas.title: Native Share Sheet For Results
ideas.why: The Web Share API lets web apps open the phone's own share sheet for text and links; it needs a user tap and HTTPS, and support varies, so feature-detect and keep a fallback.
